messages:
Maria: Morning — quick async standup for gateway/routing/auth/rate limits.
Maria: Yesterday: finished the fallback routing patch for models with incompatible KV cache; ran integration against staging.
Maria: Blockers: seeing intermittent 429s in staging for burst traffic on /v1/generate, looks like token-bucket config not applied to the new edge pool.
Maria: Today: will dig into the rate limiter policy propagation and open a small patch to add burst allowance per-edge. Ping me if you want pairing. :coffee:

Ash: Thanks — can you paste the policy snippet you deployed?

Maria: Sure — current applied snippet (staging):
```
route: /v1/generate
policies:
  auth: required
  rate_limit:
    type: token_bucket
    capacity: 500
    refill_per_minute: 300
    burst: 20
    per_edge: true
```

Ash: Looks like capacity is low for the new edge; should be per-second tuned not per-minute for low-latency bursts.

Liam: FYI I saw similar 429s last week when we rolled the dedicated pools. I opened an issue with graphs, cc @Maria.

Liam: Repro steps: ramp test 2x qps for 30s, observe spikes at ~18s, then token bucket drains and 429 flood for ~40s.

Sophia: Is JWT rotation on that path up-to-date? If auth rejects are mixed into 429 signals we need to separate them in the metrics.

Maria: Good call — I ran a quick grep and the new edge had the old KID mapping. I'll rotate and push, but want to fix the rate policy first to avoid user impact.

Oliver: PR for the fallback routing patch is ready: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/482. Needs one more review (Ash?). The patch includes a small change to policy inheritance precedence.

Ash: I'll review in a bit. Quick note — please add a tiny unit test for per-edge bucket logic.

deploy-bot: deploy started for staging/gateway-edge-3 at 2025-03-12T09:17:40Z
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded for staging/gateway-edge-3 (rev a9f3d2) 2025-03-12T09:19:12Z

Maria: Thanks — after deploy I'll run the ramp test again and post graphs. If still noisy I'll rollback the edge pool and switch routing to pool B as temporary fallback.

Sophia: If you need help with auth rotation I can assist after 10:30am PT.

Maria: Appreciated — will ping you. Also tagging @Oliver for the test plan: can you add a quick canary traffic profile and the seed script?

Oliver: On it, will add a small k6 script to the PR and push in ~20m.

Maria: Cool — main ask for the day: reviewers for PR 482 and someone to monitor staging dashboards for the next 45m. I'll post results here. :eyes:
